text.zh: 脚心相对，背挺直慢慢往前倾
text.en: Press your soles together and lean forward with a long back

text.zh: 脚跟靠近身体，膝盖自然往两边打开。
text.en: Bring your heels in and let your knees fall open.

text.zh: 保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
text.en: Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.

text.zh: 别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。
text.en: Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

commonErrors.en: Rounding your back to reach forward.
Forcing your knees down with your hands.

cautions.zh: 大腿内侧疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your inner thighs hurts, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 剂量 30 s 保持 → 2 组×4 次（rep_hold，stretchLoop）
口令「保持呼吸」→「停住呼吸」
按用户决定改为静态保持计时，动画只作示意
剂量 → 2 组×30 秒，休息 15 秒；口令/要点改为进入-保持-呼气放松，去掉来回/计数描述
